A chunked prefill request lives in self.chunked_req between forwards and was re-added every step, so an abort waited for the whole prefill; acknowledged cleanup returned 504 cleanup_timeout and later episodes failed setup (PyramidKV r25 held cell, and the CommitKV CUDA check in blocker_cuda_validation_20260922.json).
change: abort_request also marks the matching chunked multi-round C2KV request

get_next_batch_to_run finishes an aborted chunked C2KV request right after stashing it, through the existing mid-prefill C2KV failure path (release pins, release_kv_cache(is_insert=False), stream the abort finish)

a persistent-history turn aborted mid-prefill (at a chunk boundary or requeued between rounds) sets persistent_history_eviction_failed so SessionAwareCache rolls the session back to its previous turn; before, the requeued case would try to save a partial ledger

scope_of_the_fix: A deadline that fires during prefill now costs only that task: the engine stops at the next 512-token chunk, releases the turn and accepts the next episode.

A timed-out task is still an infrastructure failure and the BFCL completion ledger still refuses the cell; the deadline must still exceed every request (3600 s recommended for bfcl_long reference-attention cells).
The chunk-boundary abort applies with --disable-overlap-schedule, which every paper server command sets.
